note: Planning only: predicts the gas of one native-lane ILedger.execute publication from its actions, so the SDK can split a large write into publications without an eth_estimateGas round trip per guess. eth_estimateGas stays the authority before sending. Excluded: the 21,000 intrinsic cost and calldata (EIP-2028/7623; computable from the encoded transaction), refunds (EIP-3529; not applied, so the model errs high on clears), the signed lane, guards and STAGE/COMMIT.

method.amsterdam: FOUNDRY_PROFILE=amsterdam FOUNDRY_OUT=out/amsterdam FOUNDRY_CACHE_PATH=cache/amsterdam (solc experimental amsterdam target; never release bytes)
method.measurement: vm.lastFrameGas() of the execute call frame (gasTotalUsed, and gasStateUsed under amsterdam); every account the setUp touched is cooled (vm.cool) before each measured execute, so each publication pays the cold costs of a transaction of its own; the principal has written before except in the first-write pair
method.marginal: cost of one action = gas(k = 2) − gas(k = 1) of two publications of the same shape with distinct bodies
method.slopes: perWord and perByte: least squares of the files-bytes/1 marginal over body sizes 64, 100, 1000, 1024, 4096, 8192 (100 and 1,000 are not word multiples, which separates the two terms); publishNew[shape] = its marginal − perWord·ceil(n/32) − perByte·n, averaged over the measured sizes (fit.publishNewBaseBySize)
method.fixed: median of 2·gas(k = 1) − gas(k = 2) over every pair (fit.impliedFixedByPair: the first action of a kind in a publication pays some cold state that later ones find warm, which this single constant averages)
method.firstWriteSurcharge: (CREATE + PUBLISH files-directory/1 as a principal's first publication ever) − (the same shape by a principal that has written once)
method.keys: PUBLISH new: publishNew[shape] + perWord·ceil(n/32) + perByte·n, n = body bytes; FOLDER binds run FilesFinalValidator; rebind = CAS to a new target; UNBIND/RELEASE from BOUND; WITHDRAW of one occurrence
method.tagLevels: a first TAG statement (either sign) on an n-word topic = bindTagFresh (no author has stated anything at the position) or bindTagSecondAuthor (the position exists; measured as a first yes, which files one place entry, so it is an upper bound for a first no there) + Σ over its n − 1 proper ancestors of tagLevel.mineNew | mineExisting (the author's scope-below list at that ancestor is empty | not) + (a fresh position, either sign, or a first yes at an existing position: every filing) tagLevel.sharedNew | sharedExisting (the place-below list at that ancestor is empty | not); a list with exactly 1 entry or a multiple of 5 takes a fresh word on its next append, so price it as new. Measured: (k2 − k1) / 4 of a first statement on a 2-word and on a 6-word topic from the same state (rows "tag level all new | all existing": a first tag at a fresh position; "mine new | mine existing": a first no at an existing position, which files nothing below); shared = all − mine

validation.what: M1 create file: CREATE, PUBLISH root form 0 (18-byte document), PUBLISH name (10 B), BIND HEAD, BIND FOLDER (first entry of a folder)
edit: PUBLISH child form 0 (18-byte document), BIND HEAD rebind
rename + move (EfsFiles.move): PUBLISH name (9 B), RELEASE FOLDER, BIND FOLDER fresh (another folder)
two 8,192-byte files-bytes/1 records (16,384 body bytes, the publication cap)
last publication of a 40,000-byte file: chunk 4 (7,392 B), four spans, files-content/1 carrier 2, CREATE, root form 1, name (7 B), BIND HEAD, BIND FOLDER
a first tag on a fresh 6-word path: the fresh-position term plus five levels, every per-author and shared roll-up new

amsterdam.quantity: frame gas + frame state gas (EIP-8037 execution + state)

split.note: constants = executionGas + stateGas (up to rounding); the EIP-7825 per-transaction cap (2^24) counts executionGas only
